What to look for: the shader declares a struct with a user-defined cast to bool and then
uses a value of that struct type directly as an `if` condition. Read each pane's diagnostics
rather than its output, and note that no pane produces DXIL for this input.

DXC 1.6.2112 (the oldest DXC on Compiler Explorer, and the oldest release that can compile
this at all) accepts the operator declaration and rejects only the `if` condition: the
operator is not considered for the implicit conversion, which is what this issue reports.

DXC trunk reports that same error plus a second one, on the operator declaration itself --
current DXC refuses the declaration outright. The requested feature is no less absent; the
construct now fails earlier.

The Clang pane is the successor HLSL front end. Compare whether it accepts the same source.
